description: Labeled multi-agent traces for benchmarking the inter-agent disagreement engine. Each case is a sequence of agent outputs within one trace. Unlike v1.0_dev/val/test (single-agent: evidence + one claim), these cases contain 2-5 agent outputs so cross-agent contradiction detection can actually be exercised — THRESHOLD_ANALYSIS.md notes ablation Config E was untestable on the single-agent splits. Cases are hand-constructed. 'contradicting_pair' names the two agents that genuinely conflict (null when the trace is internally consistent); 'adjacent' records whether that pair is consecutive in the trace, since the engine as wired in evaluator.py only ever compares an agent against its immediate upstream.
